title: Wings live: Lewisham Odeon, London | 1979
content:
Wings performed at the Lewisham Odeon in London, England, on 3 December 1979.

It was the ninth night of the 19-date Wings UK Tour 1979, and the first of six non-consecutive nights at three different London venues.

The Beatles had performed at the Lewisham Odeon on 29 March and 8 December 1963.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Laurence Juber on guitar; and Steve Holley on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.
